contexts.text: The spiritual man... also becomes the seventh: not the seventh day, like the celestial man; but the seventh month. AC 852.
The tenth month () = the truths which are of remains.
In the beginning, in the first of the month () = the first termination.
The second month () = every state before regeneration.
The last time of the Church is signified by the third day, the third month, etc.
He dwelt with him a month of days () = a new state of life.

Months, etc. = states, the quality of which appears from the numbers... But when a month, etc. is mentioned in the singular, there is signified an entire state; thus the end of a former and the beginning of the following one... Here, therefore, by a month is signified the end of the former state and the beginning of the following one; thus a new state; as also elsewhere in the Word. Illustrated.
Yielding its fruit every month () = a state always new as to the reception of good, and its consequent exercise.

As the end of a former state and the beginning of the following one, or a new state, is signified by a month, it was commanded that the numbering of (the sons of Levi, and of the first-born males of the sons of Israel) should be from the son of a month and upwards ().
A month of days, here () manifestly = the end of a former state and the beginning of the following or new one.
About three months after () = a new state; (for) three = what is complete... and a month, a state; for all times = states... Explained. AC 4901:4.
She hid him three months () = the fulness of time in which it did not appear... A month = time and state.
This month is to you the head of the months () = that this state is the principal of all states. A month = the end of a former state and the beginning of the following one; thus a new state. AC 7828.

On the tenth of this month () = a state of the initiation of the interiors... By a month is meant an entire state from beginning to end; thus the whole state of deliverance which is signified by the Passover...

In the month Abib () = the beginning of a new state. A month = the end of a former state and the beginning of the following one; thus also a new state. That the month Abib = the beginning from which are all the following states, is evident from the things which are said about this month in the preceding chapter; namely, This month is to you the head of the months; this is the first to you in the months of the year.

Thou shalt keep this service in this month () = the perennial worship of the Lord on account of deliverance... A month = the end of a former state and the beginning of a new one... Hence also by a month is signified what is perennial.
In the fifteenth day of the second month () = the state relatively... By a month is signified the end of a former state and the beginning of the following one; thus a new state.
In the third month () = the fulness of the state. Explained. A month = a state.
A month of days = perpetually.
Let them resist evils in intention only once a week, or twice a month, and they will perceive a change.
To torment them five months () = to induce a stupor for a short time... because this is signified by five; for times, whether months, etc. do not signify time, but state. AR 439.
By an hour, a day, a month, and a year () is signified continually and perpetually, the same as by all time. AE 571.
By forty-two months () is signified even to the end, when not anything remains.
The reason they are called months, is that by a month is signified a full state. Illustrated.
Yielding its fruit every month = that the Lord produces goods with a man according to every state of truth with him. By a month is signified the state of life of man as to truth.
The reason why by months are signified the states of life as to truths, is that by months are meant the times designated by the moon. Illustrated.
By months are signified states of truth; and, in the opposite sense, states of falsity with man. Illustrated.
The infants speak in the angelic language within a month.

By the products of the months () are signified all things which proceed from the Spiritual Kingdom of the Lord. Months here = the same as moons; namely, truths from good; for, in the Original Language, there is the same word for both.
Five months = so long as they are in that state. AE 561.
For a month = a state... The reason months = states, is that all the times in the Word... = states of life.
Occurs.

For forty-two months = even to the end of the Old Church, and to the beginning of the New one. Months = states; here, states of the Church; for by times... are signified states, and these states are designated by the numbers...
Forty-two months () = plenary vastation and consummation; thus destruction until there is nothing of truth and good remaining.
After they have been in the Spiritual World a month, all reject the third Person...
